items.heading: Borscht
details: Key ingredients: beetroot, cabbage, beef, sour cream
Simmer beef to make a rich broth.
Add shredded beetroot, cabbage and other vegetables.
Cook until the vegetables are tender and the soup turns deep red.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream.

items.heading: Beef Stroganoff
details: Key ingredients: beef strips, mushroom, onion, sour cream
Sear beef strips quickly over high heat.
Saute mushroom and onion until golden.
Combine the beef and mushrooms with a splash of stock.
Stir in sour cream and simmer briefly before serving over noodles.
